parent: CD-08 independent deployment agent and acceptance

sources.finding: JMS Store /jms-store is KahaDB ActiveMQ persistence and is moved to shared home in Data Center.
Default shared home is {bamboo.home}/shared unless overridden via JVM/environment/application property.

One primary, shared filesystem available to all nodes; only primary returns200, normal secondaries return503. Generic shared-storage documentation does not by itself qualify this GlusterFS volume for native KahaDB locking/durability.

conclusions: The GlusterFS path holds one common symlink; its absolute target resolves separately on each host. This redirects native shared JMS persistence to node-local storage.
Creating empty local targets on61/63 would remove the directory error but would not preserve or share the current primary broker store.
Changing the shared symlink while primary60 is writing risks redirecting subsequent opens to a different store. This is not a safe per-node rolling mkdir repair.
Primary60 metadata inventory found3regular files totaling34357920bytes; file count/size is not message count, a consistent snapshot, a backup or a content-integrity proof.
Current GlusterFS metadata proves topology only, not native KahaDB locking/durability compatibility.

proposed_bounded_plan.gate: New explicit approval and fresh coordinator agreement; all physical actions remain forbidden until then.
actions: Inspect exact native broker configuration and writer/port inventory using allowlisted nonsecret metadata.

In an owned synthetic namespace outside the active JMS store, qualify cross-node exclusive locking, fsync/rename visibility and exact bundled ActiveMQ6.3.2 KahaDB stop/reopen durability. Do not open any real broker store or expose a test listener to agents.
If filesystem or native-broker qualification fails, stop before migration; no automatic filesystem replacement or Gluster service changes.

proposed_bounded_plan.gate: Explicit shared-CI outage window, submission/scheduling idle gate, target backups and rollback reviewed;62 remains stopped.
actions: Gracefully quiesce/stop61 and63 first, then primary60, and verify no surviving Bamboo/broker writer; no force kill/global pause/auth or unrelated service change by implication.

Create protected on-target original-link and cold primary-store backups. Copy the authoritative complete60store to a new shared-volume staging directory preserving owners/modes/attributes, verify complete file-set hashes while writers are stopped, and retain the original local store unchanged.

Replace the common shared symlink with the verified shared directory only while all writers are stopped; no clearing of journals/locks, empty-store replacement, data-content changes, DB schema changes or credentials retrieval.

Start60 alone against the migrated shared store; verify native RUNNING200, broker startup without KahaDB/guard failures and the original agent inventory/reconnect, without submitting builds or starting the new dedicated agent.
Use controlled one-candidate-at-a-time primary handoffs to prove61 and63 can each actually promote using the same store; do not count ONLINE/RUNNING_AS_SECONDARY alone as acceptance.

Restore healthy approved active-node inventory, leave62 stopped, verify native primary/secondary status, queues/agents and no unintended automatic-restart failures; final primary need not be forced back to60 unless explicitly required.
Send END/ABORT within the newly agreed window; no automatic extension or production application rollout.

rollback_boundary.before_first_new_store_writer: Restore original shared symlink and unchanged original60local store from protected verified metadata; restart only the reviewed recovery node after confirming no other writer.
rollback_boundary.after_any_new_store_writer: The old local copy may be stale. Do not blindly restore it or overwrite the migrated store; stop further handoffs, retain both stores, reconcile latest persisted state in a separately controlled recovery decision.

remaining_decision: Approve the gated cold migration plus planned cluster interruption and two actual promotion checks, or retain current60-primary topology and defer physical repair. The previous logging window is closed.
